reading.workResult: Global serial reconciliation correctly kept Analysis waiting and recovered Reading first. Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for exactly the three same-date Queue-selected objects. Q-20260902-01 found that working-memory evaluation must separate stored state, delivered context, management work and task/process outcome: the 55-trajectory primary study reports semantic heterogeneity, non-transfer of some calibration gains, and that equal token budgets do not imply equal delivered context or management cost. Q-20260902-02 compared official OpenAI Epic, Microsoft Copilot Studio/Entra Agent ID and OpenAI Codex implementation evidence and found a layered connector-authority boundary: administrative availability, configured agent capability, acting principal/account, target-resource permission and runtime policy are distinct propositions; the samples do not prove a universal end-to-end authorization protocol. Q-20260902-03 found that progressively loaded skill compression must preserve routing and public callable-entry contracts: SkillZip Pro reports protected compression with token savings and no quality loss in its evaluated harness while an aggressive unprotected 71% configuration loses up to 26 accuracy points. Reading produced no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication and used no prior-day Runtime artifact as a business input.
